g.text: PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; [0..1] = nullable attribute.
Each listing has one host; each booking and review has one customer.
A booking has at most one review, enforced by a unique booking_id.
Money is stored in integer cents; rating validation allows 1 through 5.
Lines show foreign-key associations, not ORM relationship properties.
Business operations live in module functions, not entity methods.
